summary: Published the staged public and authenticated staff trees on node1 TCP port 8080 using nginx. Configuration and content persisted through the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Installed Alpine-compatible nginx and HTTP password utilities.
Configured anonymous /public/ access and HTTP Basic authentication for /staff/ as reader.
Disabled directory listings and kept credential files outside served paths.
Enabled nginx in the default OpenRC runlevel.
Restarted node1 safely and verified complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Public pages are anonymously available under /public/ on TCP 8080.
evidence.summary: Public request returned HTTP 200 and its SHA-256 matched the staged public index; nginx listened on IPv4 and IPv6 port 8080.

evidence.requirement: Staff pages require HTTP Basic authentication as reader.
evidence.summary: Unauthenticated, invalid-password, and invalid-user requests returned 401 with a Basic challenge. Valid reader authentication returned content hashes matching the staged staff index and roster.

evidence.requirement: Failed authentication leaves staff content inaccessible.
evidence.summary: Failed staff requests and a traversal attempt into staff returned 401; the failure body was explicitly verified not to match staff content.

evidence.requirement: Password files and directory listings are not served.
evidence.summary: Direct, traversal, encoded-traversal, and generated-password-file requests returned 404. Autoindex is disabled and tested responses contained no directory listing.
Pre-change and post-restart SHA-256 hashes match for access.txt, public/index.html, staff/index.html, and staff/roster.csv.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel.
evidence.summary: Alpine Linux v3.23 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts were unchanged after configuration and restart.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 787a48ce-a977-4adf-a41c-6c5cdfd8d96d; reboot acknowledgement was captured; the new boot ID was 8c47577c-8b4c-4983-bbc2-7b80991c75e0; nginx, listeners, authentication boundaries, and staged data all recovered.
